D1 · Lagna Chart जन्म कुंडली · Janma Kundali
What is the D1 · Lagna Chart?

The D1 — also called the Rashi Chart or Janma Kundali — is the foundational birth chart of Vedic Jyotisha. It maps the precise positions of all nine classical planets (Nava Graha) across the twelve houses (Bhavas) at the exact moment and place of birth.

Why it matters: The D1 is the primary chart from which all life themes are read — personality, health, relationships, career, dharma, and fate. Every other divisional chart (D9, D10, etc.) is a refinement of a specific dimension of the D1. The D1 shows what is promised; the divisional charts show whether and how it manifests. No Jyotisha analysis begins without first establishing the D1 firmly.

D9 · Navamsha Chart
नवांश कुंडली · Navamsha Kundali
—
What is the D9 · Navamsha Chart?

The D9 divides each of the twelve Rashis into nine equal parts of 3°20′, producing the Navamsha — a second chart that reveals the deeper, more private dimension of the birth chart. Where the D1 shows what is visible and promised, the D9 shows what actually manifests in the lived experience.

Why it matters: A planet strong in D1 but weak in D9 is Viphala — a false promise. A planet weak in D1 but strong in D9 is Prachanna — a hidden gem. The D9 is also the primary chart for assessing marriage, the spouse's qualities, and the ultimate spiritual purpose of the life. No planet can be fully understood without reading its D1 and D9 together.

वैवाहिक · The Conception War Room
Garbha · Will conception take hold?

The Garbha sub-module judges conception-related queries through the Karya Success Chain to the 5th house (Putra Bhava), Tajik aspect between the Lagna Lord (you) and the 5th Lord (the child-yet-to-be), the Bhava Bala of the 5th with Beeja/Kshetra Sphuta filters, and modern Tajik signals for assisted-conception and adoption paths. Returns a clear verdict — YES, YES with delays, CONDITIONAL via intervention or third party, HIGH RISK with miscarriage flags, or NO — along with a tender, action-oriented narrative.

॥ Cast Garbha Reading ॥
The Lagna is derived from the first consonant of this single word per the Pavarga table. If the consonant is outside the table, the engine falls back to time-based casting.
Querent (asks the question)
Drives Beeja (male) vs Kshetra (female) Sphuta — the fertility coordinate filter. For male querents asking about a partner's conception, the engine auto-pivots the chart to the wife's 5th-from-7th.

              👶  Putra · Progeny & Children
              पुत्र · Family Capacity & Child Development
              Putra · Two routes, one engine

              This module handles two distinct families of Putra questions and routes them differently per Prashna Marga Ch.16. Ask about family size, conception capacity, or how many children — the engine reads the 5th house, the 5th lord, and Jupiter (Putra Karaka), with the Saptamsha (D7) as the long-horizon anchor. Ask about an existing child's speech, development, milestones, or wellbeing — the chart pivots: the 5th house becomes the child's own Lagna, speech reads from the 2nd-of-5th (= 6th of the radix), and Mercury (Vak-karaka) replaces Jupiter as the operative significator. The intent is auto-detected from your question, but you can override it below.

              ॥ Cast the Prashna Chart ॥
              Auto-detect uses keyword classification. The engine looks for markers like "my child", "speech", "school", "development" to route to the child-development path. Override manually if the auto-detect picks wrong.

Skip this if you do not know your Lagna; the Prashna answer remains valid on its own.

              💼  Vritti · Career & Authority
              वृत्ति · Throne · Pivot · Exit
              Vritti · Four routes, one engine

              This module reads four distinct families of career question and routes them surgically per Tajik Neelkanthi Ch.13. Promotion / elevation reads the 10th — the throne of action — with Sun as the status karaka. Employer relationship pivots to the 4th house via the Corporate Master Pivot — the 4th is the 10th-from-7th, the boss's own throne. Startup pivot reads the 7th as your founder identity, with the L7-vs-L10 architecture as the key test. Exit / resignation reads the 12th — Vyaya Bhava, the severance axis — with Overlay C's abdication_signal as the dominant trigger. The intent is auto-classified from your question; override below if needed. The Karmika transformation hook is always live: Saturn in the 10th in a Fixed or own sign re-labels as Standing Power (Sthira); Mars in the 10th re-labels as Executive Command (Mangala Digbala) regardless of sign.

              ॥ Cast the Prashna Chart ॥
              Auto-detect classifies by keyword precedence: "fire", "laid off", "resign", "severance" → exit; "quit", "start business", "founder", "equity" → startup; "boss", "CEO", "board", "reporting" → employer; "promotion", "raise", "title" → elevation (default). Override if the auto-detect picks wrong.
               · 
              When you supply your natal Lagna, the engine performs a horary-to-natal handshake — cross-referencing the Prashna against your birth promise. Particularly useful for career questions where natal 10th activation matters. Skip if unknown.

              🏆  Sammana · Recognition & Honour
              सम्मान · Accolade · Validation · Public Standing
              Sammana · Two routes, one engine

              This module reads the intangible socio-professional currency — reputation, formal accolades, peer/public validation, internal recognition, credit attribution. Unlike Vritti (which reads title/salary/scope), Sammana reads whether the world acknowledges you on record. Two routes per Tajik Neelkanthi Ch.14: Industry Award reads the 11th — Labha Bhava, the public reception arena — with Jupiter as the honor karaka. Internal Validation pivots to the 10th — the vertical authority axis — with Sun as the radiance karaka. The 5-state verdict vocabulary captures the full shape: YES (Radiant Validation), YES_WITH_FRICTION (peer envy), CONDITIONAL_PRIVY (private-only recognition), OBSCURED_VALIDATION (credit theft, including the Yama Binder manager-interception pattern), and NO. The L3-L11 commendation axis runs as a modifier: PUBLIC_COMMENDATION if the channel is open, MUTED_RECEPTION if it's decoupling.

              ॥ Cast the Prashna Chart ॥
              The recognition_scope enum is the authoritative routing signal — INDUSTRY_AWARD + PEER_ACKNOWLEDGMENT route to the H11/Jupiter axis; INTERNAL_VALIDATION + EXECUTIVE_BOARD_RECOGNITION route to the H10/Sun axis. Leave on auto-detect to let the engine classify from your question keywords.
               · 
              When you supply your natal Lagna, the engine performs a horary-to-natal handshake — cross-referencing the Prashna against your birth promise. Particularly useful for recognition questions where natal H11/H10 activation matters. Skip if unknown.
